'''Adelin''' is a [[Maiden of the Spear]] of the [[Jindo]] sept of the [[Taardad]] [[Aiel]]. 

==Appearance==
She is yellow-haired and handsome, but she has a hard face. She also has a scar that cuts across her cheek, and is a hand shorter than Rand and ten years older than Rand.

==Activities==
She was one of the Maidens who played Maiden's Kiss with Mat and was leader of the Maidens who were Rand's escort in [[Rhuidean]]. She brings word to Rhuarc that there is trouble at Imre Stand.{{ref/book|4|37}} She provides the bracelet to Rand that he gives to Aviendha and then begins the tea ceremony showing the maiden's approval of Rand.{{ref/book|4|50}} She deflects [[Couladin]]'s spear when he is trying to stab Rand at [[Alcair Dal]].{{ref/book|4|57}}

She accompanies Rand when he leaves [[Rhuidean]]. 

When she takes off to dance the spears during a night attack on the Aiel's camp by Shadowsworm, [[Rand al'Thor]] is attacked by [[Draghkar]]. When she and the rest of the Maidens who were supposed to be guarding him are found out, they all receive punishments from the [[Wise Ones]] in the form of carrying a doll.

She, along with [[Jolien]] and [[Enaila]], shaved [[Isendre]] bald and beat her with nettles after catching her again trying to sneak into Rand's bed in [[Eianrod]], [[Cairhien]].
